newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India follows strong Bombay higher.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India follows strong Bombay higher.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts posted strong gains on Monday, following a good run in Bombay earlier and amid steady foreign investor interest, dealers said.
"There have been gains across the board, with some buying also coming through in the second tier stocks," said one dealer.
He said GDR strength followed gains in Bombay as funds there looked to boost values ahead of the end of the half-year.
Volumes were seen firm despite Hong Kong's closure.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 1.36 points firmer at 90.05, up 1.53 percent, with the premium over the local market at 25.31 percent from 25.95 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 122.85 points to 4,265.09.
Indian Hotels added 47 cents to $35.00/36.00 and State Bank of India rose 62 cents to $26.00/27.00.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed down 0.48 points, or 0.64 percent, at 74.48 points, a premium of 37.02 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 1.70 points lower at 132.20, representing a discount to the local market of 2.08 percent.
Traders said the market was set for further strength amid strong retail interest in local stocks, but had struggled ahead of a local market closure on Tuesday.
